about: Modwerk source-only velocity-humanise package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/velocity-humanise.

mods.title: Velocity Humanise
mods.summary: Per track, every trig's velocity gets a random offset of up to ±N, set with FUNC + VEL on the TRIG page.
mods.description: Velocity Humanise gives each track a random velocity offset: every trig's velocity moves by a random amount up to ±N, clamped to 1..127. N is one of sixteen steps from 0 to 64, set by holding FUNC and turning VEL on the TRIG page, where the label reads RND and the knob becomes a sixteen-position selector. N is per pattern track, kept in core-ar2's mod storage and saved with the pattern. It is an elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0003-velocity-humanise, with his code unchanged apart from the storage port and FUNC + VEL's turn and text, which now go through core-ar2's parameter table (core_params) instead of two detours of his own.
mods.author: Iced-Cream
mods.on_unit: On an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, as reported by the author: build P4A4 (core-ar2 0.4 with all eleven rytm2_mods ports, this module at 1.2) passed FUNC + VEL reading RND through N's sixteen values, VEL alone as stock, and N kept through a power-cycle without a project save; 1.1's velocity spread was measured on SXH4 and VHH4 (core-ar2 0.3). This package's own bytes, and the Modwerk base, have not been flashed from the site.
